analysis: GTEx empirical SNP overlap at labeled Alu editing sites

required_inputs.role: Existing GTEx-derived tissue editing tables used to rebuild the labeled Alu-site inventory.
Existing Alu-pair BED used to recover pair IDs and strand orientation.

required_inputs.path: EXTERNAL controlled-access: GTEx v8 donor genotype VCF (dbGaP/AnVIL)
required_sidecars: EXTERNAL controlled-access: GTEx v8 donor genotype VCF (dbGaP/AnVIL).tbi or EXTERNAL controlled-access: GTEx v8 donor genotype VCF (dbGaP/AnVIL).csi when using a compressed VCF
required_inputs.role: Indexed GTEx genotype VCF/BCF used for the empirical donor-aware overlap scan.

variant_modes_reported: direct genomic A/G at the site coordinate
strand-aware transcript-equivalent A/G (A/G on plus-strand sites, T/C on minus-strand sites)
